newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile October inflation at 0.7 percent - source.
newsitem.headline: Chile October inflation at 0.7 percent - source.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 0.7 percent in October against 0.8 percent in the same month a year ago, said a government source.
Consumer prices increased 0.5 percent in September which brought the rise in the first nine months of the year to 5.1 percent.
The National Statistics Institute will give the official inflation figure and the latest industrial production and unemployment data at 1030 local (1330 GMT).
